description: Sonic Adventure 2 (Xbox Live Arcade), statically recompiled with ReXGlue and drawn with deko3d: 60 FPS at stock clocks. Needs your own Xbox 360 copy, converted on a PC.

notes: A forwarder must be set to a 39-bit address space.
Hold A+B+X+Y+L+R for the game menu.

inputs.label: Game files made by the web installer from your Xbox 360 copy

options.label: sa2-nx.zip, extracted to the SD root

prepare.summary: The installer page converts your Xbox 360 package in the browser: movies to H.265, music to Opus, everything else into one pack.

generated.note: Settings; delete it to get the defaults back

steps: Give it the package file 525E7BB1E72A2DB99AB79281BA24938048198FAD58, or the whole 58411202 folder from your Xbox 360 (the Battle DLC is optional), and press Create sa2-nx.zip.
Extract sa2-nx.zip to the root of the SD card. It makes switch/sa2-nx/.
